overview: A relocation clause in a commercial lease allows a landlord to move a tenant to a different, usually similar, space within the same building or complex, often to accommodate larger tenants or optimize space usage. It is common in retail/office leases and typically requires the landlord to cover all moving costs, ensuring no out-of-pocket expenses for the tenant.
